Welcome to SUPER SOLDIER TRAINING LAB!
Where you become useful beans and help you do your solemn duty!
Just do as I say and follow the crash course.
This is the first tutorial course so if you are smarter than squirrels. There would be no problem!
Sigh... Let’s hope you’re more competent than the last batch.
But remember both of you need to cross. So use your airgun creatively.
Good, If you activate the bean pipe, consider that as a checkpoint for the course.
If your dumb partner is dead, We will slide another one of the clones through the pipe right away.
This is the second tutorial course. It seems you two were smarter than average beans.
This is the third and the last tutorial course. Most beans aren't getting this far, so congrats.
Maybe you think this tutorials are too easy.
But remember, most beans can't even open the peanut butter jar.
Congrats on finishing all three tutorial.
Finally we can do some real tests.
This section will cover the basics of the grappling hook.
You’ve probably already messed around with it on the way here—but I’ll explain it anyway.
Operate it as shown on the wall. Hook it onto surfaces and adjust the length as needed.
Once hooked, you can swing side to side to reach farther. Use it wisely.
Oh, and by the way—that blue barrier you passed? It disintegrates everything that isn't you or your tools.
Can’t have you sneaking junk out of here, can we?
Now, let’s go over the basics of the air gun.
Given how sluggish you are, you’ll probably need it more than most.
Use the air gun as shown. Suck things in, then shoot them out.
You can even suck in your partner—if they’re hooked onto something, you’ll get pulled to them.
And while you’re latched on, firing the air gun will propel you—use that to get over obstacles.
See that multi-purpose drone flying overhead?
If you hit what it’s carrying with the air gun propelled objects, it’ll drop it.
Go on, give it a try.
Now it’s time to use both of your tools to clear a basic obstacle.
Based on your Bean University scores, this should be a cakewalk.
Since you passed the obstacle, you’re now entering the zone where most test subjects tend to fail.
Let’s hope your head doesn’t explode from thinking too hard.
Miraculous. Test subjects with functioning brains—haven’t seen that in ages.
Go on, grab the key and get moving.
Alright, now that you've learned all the basics, it's time to start the final test course.
I hope you succeed this time, unlike the ones before you.
Took you long enough. But at least you made it through the course, so that’s something.
Well done. You did bring the key, right?
[Horrifying!] But worry not! With the cutting-edge technology of our super lab, we can reproduce as many times as needed!
They sure do die a lot! That one is on their [/1st] reproduction now.
What, dead again? I expected a lot of deaths, but this is already their [/1st] time.
Ah, they died. What number was it again…? Oh right, [/1st]!
